panels.title: gRPC Calls by RPC Method & Status (5m)
panels.description: Calls and error composition for the gRPC OrderService. grpc_calls_total{rpc_method,status}. Error rate derivable from the same counter (status != OK). Labels bounded: rpc_method in {CancelOrder, GetOrder}; status in {OK, NOT_FOUND, FAILED_PRECONDITION, ...}.

panels.title: HTTP Cancel Calls by Status - PATCH /api/v1/orders/{order_id} (5m)
panels.description: Same operation through the HTTP transport. Count by status comes from the existing http_request_duration_seconds histogram (its _count series), filtered to the cancel endpoint. Path label is now the route template (bounded) after the Part C fix.

panels.title: gRPC Error Rate by RPC Method (status != OK, 5m)
panels.description: Error rate = rate of grpc_calls_total where status is not OK. Derived from the call counter, so no separate error counter is needed.

panels.title: HTTP Cancel Error Rate (non-2xx, 5m)
panels.description: Error rate for the HTTP cancel operation = rate of histogram _count where status is not 2xx.

panels.title: gRPC Handler Duration p50 & p95 (5m window, server-side)
panels.description: Duration measured at the SERVER (the handler wraps the call with perf_counter). p50 and p95 over a 5m window, grouped by rpc_method.

panels.title: HTTP PATCH Duration p50 & p95 (5m window, server-side)
panels.description: Same cancel operation through HTTP. Duration measured at the SERVER (FastAPI middleware) over a 5m window.

panels.title: gRPC In-Flight Calls by RPC Method
panels.description: In-flight chosen OVER message size: these are unary RPCs with small, fixed-size protobuf payloads (~hundreds of bytes), so message size is near-constant and uninformative; in-flight calls reveal concurrency and stuck handlers. Gauge returns to 0 between calls.

panels.title: Orders by Status (missing A1 metric)
panels.description: Identified gap in A1: only pending count was tracked. jewellery_orders_by_status{status} is computed from the shared SQLite DB at scrape time, so it stays accurate whether an order was cancelled via REST or via the gRPC service. Bounded label set: pending / cancelled / fulfilled.
